title: A/P Detail: Clear all filters keeps the date and resets the rest
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations: your current location and your other location.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a vendor with open bills only at your other location, none 61 to 90 days past due, on yesterday's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the as-of date set to yesterday, only that vendor ticked in the Vendor filter, "61-90 days" ticked in the Past due filter and only your current location ticked in the Location filter.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." and a "Clear all filters" button.

Step 2:

  • Rows show again.
  • The as-of date is still yesterday.
  • The chips read "Vendor: All vendors", "Past due: Any" and "Location: All locations" (every location ticked).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R5: “While a report loads it shows the native table progress bar. When the filters leave no rows, it shows the native empty state: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button when a customer or vendor, Past due or Location is chosen; that button keeps the as-of date and returns the customer or vendor, Past due and Location to their defaults (every location ticked).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Filters leave no rows | "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." | Native empty state with "Clear all filters"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
